name: Phẳng
description: a simple hand-drawn doodle young man with a big round white head, short spiky black hair, dot eyes, thick expressive eyebrows, tiny nose and mouth, slim stick-like limbs, wearing a light blue long-sleeve shirt, dark navy trousers and white sneakers, thick black ink outlines

poses.prompt: standing relaxed facing the viewer, arms down, neutral calm face, mouth closed
thinking, one hand on chin, other arm across belly, eyes looking up to the side, slightly puzzled
pointing with his right arm stretched out to the side (viewer's right), confident explaining face
shocked, both hands grabbing the sides of his head, huge round eyes, mouth wide open, sweat drops
very happy, both arms raised high in the air, eyes closed in joy, big open smile
sad and disappointed, shoulders slumped, head down, arms hanging, a small tear
angry, arms crossed on chest, frowning heavily with angled eyebrows, small anger marks
facepalm, one hand covering his face, head tilted down, other arm hanging
shrugging, both palms up at shoulder height, eyebrows raised, awkward smile
giving a thumbs up with one hand, cheeky wink and grin
walking to the viewer's right, side view, left leg forward right leg back, arms swinging
walking to the viewer's right, side view, legs passing each other under the body, arms close to the body
running fast to the viewer's right, side view, leaning forward, legs wide apart, motion lines, panicked face

variants.edit: keep the image exactly identical (same pose, same lines, same background), only change the mouth so it is open as if speaking
keep the image exactly identical (same pose, same lines, same background), only change the eyes so they are closed (two short curved lines)
